items.title: SEETEL Hotels (Germany)
items.summary: German hotel group SEETEL reported a ransomware attack; systems were isolated and a forensic investigation was launched.

items.title: City of Vicksburg, Mississippi
items.summary: The City of Vicksburg is listed among October 2026 confirmed ransomware victims; group attribution is provisional.

items.title: Green Clinic (Louisiana)
items.summary: Louisiana healthcare provider Green Clinic is listed as an October victim attributed to the Wallstreet group; ransom status unknown.

items.title: University of Illinois Chicago
items.summary: UIC is listed as a victim attributed to the Booba Project group; the university has not been confirmed as paying or restoring.

items.title: Osaka Metropolitan University & IDC Frontier (Japan)
items.summary: Osaka Metropolitan University and Tokyo data-center operator IDC Frontier both appear on October 2026 ransomware victim lists.

items.title: DexCom (claimed by Redact)
items.summary: The Redact group claimed an attack on US medical device maker DexCom on Oct 10; the claim is unverified and the company has not confirmed.

items.title: KHOU 11 (claimed by LockBit 3.0)
items.summary: LockBit 3.0 listed Houston broadcaster KHOU 11 on its leak site in October 2026; not independently confirmed.

ransomware.note: Most October victims come from leak-site aggregators; group attributions are provisional until organisations confirm. Bitdefender counted 790 claimed victims in September (+30% YoY).

items.title: Google Cloud europe-west2 (London) outage
items.summary: A power event in Google's London region from 06:08 UTC on Oct 20 caused elevated errors and network failures across multiple GCP services; Google says it is mitigated for most customers.

items.title: Revolut worldwide outage (GCP knock-on)
items.summary: Revolut lost 28 services including card payments, transfers and crypto access for millions of users after the GCP London failure; Lloyds, HSBC and Royal Mail were also reported affected.

outage.note: Single-region dependency again cascaded into banking; no other major hyperscaler outage found in the past two weeks.

items.title: State Bank of India discloses cyberattack
items.summary: SBI told exchanges on Oct 21 that 3,897 customer records (names, DOB, addresses, mobiles, loan details) were stolen and leaked, after CERT-In alerted it on Oct 16.

items.title: OpenCode console breach
items.summary: OpenCode disclosed on Oct 18 a 'distillation attack' affecting 1.4% of Console users with linked Anthropic, OpenAI or Google provider keys.

items.title: ASOS customer data breach
items.summary: ASOS confirmed attackers socially engineered an employee's credentials, stole names, addresses, phones and search history, and pushed rogue app notifications to customers.

items.title: Ivanti Connect Secure zero-day exploited
items.summary: CISA urged immediate patching of an Ivanti Connect Secure flaw exploited since at least Oct 1; Volexity reports actor UTA0576 chaining it with two other bugs.

items.title: Japanese mass breaches: Nippon Columbia, Skyticket
items.summary: Trackers report Nippon Columbia exposing ~8.72M customer records and Adventure Inc. (Skyticket) ~14.6M records; primary notices not yet verified.

items.title: ETS contractor breach hits California students
items.summary: The California Department of Education notified students of a data breach at testing contractor Educational Testing Service.

items.title: Super Typhoon Champi nears Taiwan / East China
items.summary: The strongest storm of 2026 (winds to 245 km/h) is heading for Taiwan; Zhejiang and Fujian are evacuating residents, suspending ferries and halting construction, with Shanghai on watch.

items.title: Hatteras Island evacuation (coastal storm)
items.summary: Visitors were ordered off Hatteras Island on Oct 17 as a coastal storm threatened NC Highway 12.

items.title: Hurricane Isaias (Gulf Coast / Florida)
items.summary: Isaias made landfall around Oct 8–10 with at least six deaths and hundreds of thousands without power; landfall details differ between reports.

items.title: Hurricane Simon (Mexico Pacific coast)
items.summary: Simon strengthened to a major hurricane off western Mexico around Oct 9–11, bringing flash floods to Acapulco; US Embassy issued alerts.

items.title: M 6.9 — 76 km NE of Ozernovskiy, Russia (Oct 16)
items.summary: Kamchatka quake; USGS green alert, no tsunami.

items.title: M 6.3 — 197 km NW of Port-Olry, Vanuatu (Oct 20)
items.summary: Offshore Vanuatu quake; USGS green alert with tsunami flag set.

items.title: M 5.7 — 48 km WNW of Khuzdar, Pakistan (Oct 17)
items.summary: Balochistan quake; USGS yellow alert for possible casualties and damage.

physical.note: Watch Champi's track for APAC data-center and supply-chain impact (Taiwan fabs, Shanghai/Ningbo ports) over the next 48 hours.
